subject: Sprint 0 kickoff: ClearSky - transition, owners, and initial checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie.park@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint 0 kickoff: ClearSky - transition, owners, and initial checklist

Marissa / Ben — quick handoff note on ClearSky (summary first):
- Contract signed May 10; committed start-of-Sprint0 target week of 2027-05-24.
- Core objective: get staging integration + 3 inference endpoints validated within 30 days, with p50 latency < 500ms for typical clinical prompts.
- Main constraints: ClearSky will use our hosted API for prod but requires VPC staging for PHI testing; HarmonCloud will host their test environment (ops@harmoncloud.com).

What's included here: latest SOW (attached), the mutual action plan (link below), and a lightweight network matrix we captured during sales engineering. Key asks for CS/Implementation:
1) Nominate primary CS owner and technical steward by EOD Wednesday 5/19.
2) Confirm availability for a 30–45 min internal kickoff (Sales + CS + Eng) before 5/21 to align acceptance criteria and test accounts.
3) Validate required infra: service account + two GPU test nodes in HarmonCloud staging (see network_matrix_example.xlsx).

Risks called out from discovery that matter for Sprint0:
- Quantization/throughput: ClearSky will evaluate TGI-style generation for batch scoring; we should plan a QA run with reduced quantization first.
- Data residency: they'll want audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance (ask security for export onboarding).

Please see MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP-clearsky-2027 (editable).
Attachments: ClearSky_SOW_v3.pdf, network_matrix_example.xlsx, MAP-ClearSky-2027.docx

Thanks — happy to walk through any of the items on a quick call.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie.park@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint 0 kickoff: ClearSky - transition, owners, and initial checklist

Thanks Karthik — good summary. Assigning owners and first pass on plan below.

Primary CS owner: Marissa Cole (I'll own the engagement + customer success objectives)
Technical steward / integration lead: Ben Carter (will own staging infra, test harness, and perf triage)
Implementation lead (day-to-day): Tessa Morgan (will run Sprint0 activities and acceptance) — Tessa, are you available for the internal prep call next Thursday (5/20) at 10am PT?

Immediate next actions (measured):
- Marissa: create the Sprint0 runbook and acceptance checklist (attached skeleton). Target: 5/19 EOD for internal review.
- Ben: confirm HarmonCloud staging quota (2x A100-equivalent nodes) and service account with their ops team. Target: 5/19.
- Tessa: draft test plan (ingest -> infer -> audit log export) and highlight any gaps versus MAP. Target: 5/20 morning.

Primary risks / open questions to surface to the customer on kickoff:
- If HarmonCloud can't provide the GPU quota in time we may need to run a smaller perf validation on our dedicated pool and then re-run final perf in customer staging.
- Data egress / Splunk export: need security to scope log forwarding and retention.

Attachments: sprint0-acceptance-checklist.md, onboarding-risk-log.xlsx

Sophie — quick ask for you: can you confirm the internal engineering contact at ClearSky who will approve the HarmonCloud service account? If we can get that by 5/18 it will make the staging timeline much smoother.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Park <sophie.park@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint 0 kickoff: ClearSky - transition, owners, and initial checklist

Acknowledged — I will take day-to-day on Sprint0. I accept the assignment and will follow the timeline below.

Quick notes from my side after reading the MAP and SOW:
- I will need a HarmonCloud staging contact + service account by 5/19 to lock in test windows.
- For perf validation, request Ben and Eng to provision a smaller parallel run on Redwood Dedicated if HarmonCloud quotas look tight; I can own coordination.
- Please add a 20-minute intro call with ClearSky engineers during the internal kickoff so we can map IPs and firewall rules (Sophie, do any of these slots work next Wed/Thu morning?).

Proposed internal prep call windows:
- Tue 5/18: 9:00–9:30 PT or 16:30–17:00 PT
- Wed 5/19: 11:00–11:45 PT

I'll upload a first draft of the Sprint0 test plan to the MAP doc by EOD today.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the assignments — looks good to me.

Sophie: thanks for being on the thread. If you're able to share the ClearSky staging contact (name + email) and confirm the internal engineering lead, we'll lock the internal prep call for Wed 5/19 11:00 PT and send a calendar invite.

I'll also push the HubSpot deal to "Post-sign: Sprint0 planning" and attach Marissa's runbook when it's ready.

Karthik
